newsitem.title: CHINA: Dutch retailer to invest $50 mln in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Dutch retailer to invest $50 mln in Shanghai.

text.p: Dutch food retailer Royal Ahold will invest $50 million to set up 100 supermarkets in Shanghai jointly with Shanghai Zhonghui Supermarket Co, a Zhonghui official said on Friday.
Each side will own 50 percent of the supermarkets and Royal Ahold will send the general manager for the joint venture the two companies will set up, she said.
The joint venture has taken over 15 Zhonghui outlets in Shanghai, changing the name to Ahold-Zhonghui, and the number will increase to 100 by the year 2000, she said but gave no more details.
